scope: External validation of hubness correction on four datasets (CUHK-PEDES, ICFG-PEDES, AERI-PEDES, TBAPR/TBAGPR)
information_observed_at_lock_time: dataset structure, counts, identity/image split intersections (S1, S2)
cohort splits under the pre-specified rule (identity lists only, no outcomes)
engineering smoke: loader runs, batch shapes, pid alignment, loss finite, GPU memory, sim matrix shape/dtype, peak RAM
NO retrieval metric, NO hubness statistic, NO CSLS result of any kind

hypothesis.H: The paired gain of CSLS (delta R@1) is governed by hub concentration in the gallery: higher concentration yields larger gain; when the gallery is small, the query-gallery distribution is homogeneous, or hub structure is weak, the gain approaches zero or becomes negative.
hypothesis.falsifiable_prediction: Within each dataset, increasing distractor scale increases hub concentration and increases delta R@1.

permitted_dataset_specific_adaptations: classifier head dimension = number of training identities
TBAPR identity namespace remapping following official AGData offset
protocol-required sample construction per official annotations

primary_metric: delta R@1 = R@1(transductive CSLS) - R@1(no post-processing), paired on the same similarity matrix

inductive_main.bank: training-set captions of the same dataset

cuhk_validation_only_selection.selection_split: CUHK official val (1000 identities, disjoint from test in identity and image)

csls_parameters.post_hoc_test_grids: sensitivity only, never reported as main result

primary: k-occurrence skewness S_Nk at k=10 (Radovanovic et al.)
null-normalized distinct top-1 ratio (denominator = Monte-Carlo null under random ranking at the same nq/ng, 1000 draws, seed 2026)

bootstrap.no_p_value_inflation: report CIs; p-values only where already defined in the paper

distractor_scale_experiment.rationale: Positive union equals the full official gallery in all four datasets (every gallery image is a positive of some query), so distractors must come from held-out identities.

cohort_rule.procedure: A = rng.choice(sorted(test_identities), size=round(0.30*n_ids), replace=False); B = test_identities minus A
cohort_rule.queries_Q: all official test captions of identities in A (fixed across all D)
cohort_rule.positives_P: all official gallery images of identities in A, including each query's source image (fixed across all D)
cohort_rule.pool: all official gallery images of identities in B
cohort_rule.tbapr_note: cohort split is performed on the official MERGED 529 identities, not per subset
cohort_rule.aeri_note: distractor-scale runs on the official aerial-only gallery (5525)

distractor_scale_experiment.skip_rule: if D > pool size, that level is skipped; skipping is determined solely by the cohort split and is outcome-independent

csls_computation_rule.statement: r(g) depends only on the query set and column g, not on which other columns are present. r(g) is computed ONCE using cohort query set Q (NOT the full official query set).
csls_computation_rule.mandatory_assertion: On first S7 run, assert that CSLS scores obtained by slicing the precomputed r equal bitwise those obtained by recomputing on Gallery(D,seed), for at least one dataset x D x seed. If the assertion fails, stop and report.

distractor_scale_experiment.cancelled: total-gallery-aligned ng~3000 protocol (infeasible: ICFG cohort positives alone exceed 3000)

CUHK-PEDES.role: small-gallery endpoint; only validation-only parameter selection

ICFG-PEDES.known_defect: one duplicated image path with two conflicting identities (id 1 and id 5), both in train; kept as-is, disclosed

AERI-PEDES.training: (aerial_img, caption); ground_img NOT used; this is the W/O Ground single-image setting supported by the official work
AERI-PEDES.unconfirmed: which view the manually annotated test captions describe (NEED OFFICIAL CONFIRMATION); both directions reported without labelling either as the cross-view direction

TBAPR.training: (img, caption); pair_img NOT used; official evaluator never encodes pair_img
disclosed_defects: filename-level P-token overlap between train and test (54 tokens); official identity is the JSON pid field and the relation between filename tokens and physical identities is not documented
high exact-text reuse across identities in G2APS

seed_policy.trigger: if a dataset's delta R@1 has the opposite sign to the other three AND its identity-clustered 95% CI crosses zero, add ONE seed for that dataset
constraints: the first seed's result is never replaced and never pooled into main tables
the second seed appears only in a robustness footnote and changes no main-table number
whatever the second seed shows is reported
no seeds are added under any other circumstance

reporting_policy.all_results_reported: negative, null and adverse results are reported in full
reporting_policy.spearman: descriptive/exploratory appendix statistic only; units are not independent; must not appear in abstract, contributions or conclusions
reporting_policy.primary_cross_dataset_evidence: per-dataset slope sign and CI of (distractor scale -> hubness -> delta R@1), four independent directional tests
reporting_policy.external_absolute_performance: single-run descriptive; not compared against any published number; training-seed robustness is supported separately by the TAG-PEDES three-model replication (+1.03/+1.07/+0.86)

engineering_constraints.sim_matrix: float32, memmap; no full np.sort copy
engineering_constraints.bootstrap_inputs: per-query ranks/correctness/top-k indices only; similarity matrix never reopened
engineering_constraints.distractor_scale: column indexing + chunked argpartition; per-level output is an int32 rank vector only
engineering_constraints.peak_ram: recorded via ru_maxrss in every analysis JSON; hard limit 8 GB, exceed = abort

amendment_protocol.allowed_reason: technical infeasibility only; never because a result is unfavourable
amendment_protocol.procedure: create lockA_amendment_00N.json recording original clause, new clause, technical reason, timestamp, git commit, and the list of information already observed; original file and hash retained permanently; version bumped
amendment_protocol.hard_deadline: no amendment to Lock-A is permitted after Lock-B is created

text_truncation.note: max truncation 2.80% (AERI test); CUHK/ICFG below 0.3%; reported as a footnote

s4a_engineering_smoke.note: engineering-only; no retrieval metric or hub statistic was computed or observed

post_lock_policy: Engineering-only commits after this lock are permitted provided they do not alter any locked analysis clause; every S5/S7 run archives its own git_commit.txt.
